description: Latest new token launches on Base (any DEX GeckoTerminal indexes: Uniswap v2/v3/v4, Aerodrome, Bankr, launchpads) and Solana (mostly pump.fun bonding curves), up to 20 per chain, each run through our automated risk check at request time: Base gets verified source, proxy/upgradeability, owner type, mint/pause/blacklist/fee selectors; Solana gets mint and freeze authority, metadata mutability, Token-2022 extensions, holder concentration and pump.fun curve progress. Includes pool age, liquidity, FDV and 1h buys/sells. Source: GeckoTerminal's public new-pools feed (newest first, one row per new token), checked live at request time. Heuristics, not an audit. Costs $0.02.
name: launch_feed
